style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: The naval support research tree includes all technologies which are not direct derivatives of ship hulls. For the most part, these technologies include new or improved naval weaponry, but also includes technologies for improving troop transports used during naval invasions and a few technologies for reducing the effect of incoming critical hits and for sweeping waters of hostile mines.
With the introduction of special projects in ⟦0⟧ and the accompanying ⟦1⟧, all naval support technologies now also generate naval engineering breakthrough progress while being researched.
Naval GunneryBasic design for the training and elevation mechanics of naval guns.

Basic Light BatteryAn open, powered mount for a small-caliber gun for use on smaller ships. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships.

Basic Medium BatteryA powered turret with two or three guns of medium caliber for use on cruisers. Mounting a Light Medium Battery module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. Mounting a Medium Battery module increases Heavy Gun Attack, which helps with engaging enemy Capital Ships.

Mounting a Light Medium Battery module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. Unlocks 1 38 cm Cannon Heavy attack: 22.0 Heavy piercing: 40.0 Max speed: -7% Production cost: 1750

Advanced Light BatteryAn advanced twin mount brings significantly more firepower to bear under armored protection. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships.
Unlocks 130 mm RF. Cannon Light attack: 3.0 Light piercing: 2.5 Max speed: -2% Production cost: 175

Advanced Medium BatteryBy integrating power loading and remote power control, modern cruisers can reach rates of fire and accuracy that was hitherto considered impossible. Mounting a Light Medium Battery module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. Mounting a Medium Battery module increases Heavy Gun Attack, which helps with engaging enemy Capital Ships.

Small-Caliber Semi-Armor Piercing ShellA compromise between armor-piercing performance and explosive power, this shell does significantly more damage after punching through the weak armor of light ships.

Destroyers, Light Cruisers, Heavy Cruisers, Battleships, Battlecruisers, Carriers
Small-Caliber Armor Piercing ShellA proper armor-piercing shell for small caliber guns gives destroyers and other light ships a fighting chance against armored opponents.
Armor-Piercing Capped Medium ShellBy fitting a ballistic hood, shells can be made more aerodynamic while still maintaining their armor-piercing performance.
Upgrades Light Cruisers Light attack: +5% Light piercing: +5% Heavy Cruisers Heavy attack: +5% Heavy piercing: +5%

Super-Heavy Armor Piercing ShellWeighing well over a ton, these massive shells strike with unprecedented power and pose a dire threat to even the heaviest armor.

Basic Dual-Purpose BatteryCombining anti-ship and anti-air guns in a single mount allows for more flexibility and saves weight. Mounting this module increases Light Gun Attack, which helps in engaging enemy Screening Ships. These modules also increase Anti-Air Attack. Mounting a Secondary Battery Module gives a Cruiser, Carrier, or Heavy Ship a small amount of Light Gun Attack and allows it to engage a second target.

Basic TorpedoA self-propelled weapon with an explosive warhead that runs on a pre-determined course until it hits the target below the waterline. Mounting this module on Light Ships or Cruisers allows them to do significant damage to enemy Capital Ships.
Unlocks 3x 450mm Torpedo Launcher Torpedo attack: 18.0 Max speed: -1% Production cost: 90

Improved Ship Torpedo LauncherStronger motors allow more tubes to be installed in a single mount and be trained on target faster. Mounting this module on Light Ships or Cruisers allows them to do significant damage to enemy Capital Ships.
Unlocks 4x 450mm Torpedo Launcher Torpedo attack: 24.0 Max speed: -2% Torpedo hit chance: +1% Production cost: 120

Advanced Ship Torpedo LauncherLarger diameter tubes allow for bigger torpedoes with heavier warheads. Mounting this module on Light Ships or Cruisers allows them to do significant damage to enemy Capital Ships.
Unlocks 3x 533mm Torpedo Launcher Torpedo attack: 30.0 Max speed: -3% Torpedo hit chance: +1.5% Production cost: 150

Modern Ship Torpedo LauncherPowerful compressed air charges allow heavier torpedoes to be launched at higher speeds. Mounting this module on Light Ships or Cruisers allows them to do significant damage to enemy Capital Ships.
Unlocks 4x 533mm Torpedo Launcher Torpedo attack: 36.0 Max speed: -4% Torpedo hit chance: +2% Production cost: 180

Magnetic DetonatorA new detonator detects the shift in the earth's magnetic field when the torpedo passes under the target. An explosion directly under a ship causes much more damage and often breaks the keel of the target, sinking it instantly.
Upgrades Destroyers, Submarines, Light Cruisers, Heavy Cruisers Torpedo attack: +20%
Destroyers, Submarines, Light Cruisers, Heavy Cruisers
Homing TorpedoEquipped with an accoustic detector, the torpedo can home in on the biggest source of noise ahead of it - usually the target.
Upgrades Destroyers, Submarines, Light Cruisers, Heavy Cruisers Torpedo hit chance: +10%

Electric TorpedoInstead of leaving an easily-detected trail of bubbles, a torpedo with an electrical engine remains practically invisible until it hits. This also means that there is no trail leading back to the launching submarine.
Fire Fighting DrillsEvery member of a ship's crew, from the Captain down to the simple sailor, must be able to help in containing and fighting fires onboard the ship.
Global stats Chance to receive critical hit: -10% Effects of sustained critical hits: -10%
Separate Fire MainsBy separating the main water lines around the ship, the probability of a hit rendering the ship completely unable to fight fires is much reduced.
Diesel-powered Emergency PumpsWith heavy pumps usually dependent on the main engines for power, a single and fairly light hit in the engine room may render the ship unable to stay afloat.
Bracket ShootingTo hit the target, the first step is to straddle it by firing a few guns at a time until the impacts hit on both sides of the target.
Upgrades Battleships, Battlecruisers Light attack: +5% Heavy attack: +5%

Ladder ShootingInstead of firing over the target and losing track of the impacts behind the enemy ship, shots are deliberately dropped short of the target and the distance between impact and target measured to determine the range.
Upgrades Battleships, Battlecruisers Light attack: +10% Heavy attack: +10% Heavy Cruisers Light attack: +5% Heavy attack: +5%

Shell DyesAdding small color packages to the shells when they are fired colors the impacts around the target and allows multiple ships to engage the same target without being confused by each other's impacts.
Upgrades Battleships, Battlecruisers Light attack: +15% Heavy attack: +15% Heavy Cruisers, Light Cruisers Light attack: +10% Heavy attack: +10% Destroyers Light attack: +5% Heavy attack: +5%
Transport ShipShip designed solely for troop movement, without any defensive capabilities.
Global stats Troop convoy requirements: -33% Naval invasion capacity: +10
